title: Industrial implementation of bifacial PERC+ solar cells and modules: Present status and future opportunities
version: Photovoltaics International, pp. 46–54; ISFH catalogues the publication as 2017
lineage: Original research article by the ISFH group, hosted by the trade journal. Its quoted LONGi cell results come from company communication; its engineering comparison is the researchers’ own.

passages.locator: pp. 46–47, Introduction and Figure 1; p. 54, reference [1]
passages.note: The paper cites Blakers et al. 1989 for the parent PERC design. Bifacial PERC+ retains the processing sequence of industrial PERC but uses a patterned aluminum rear grid that exposes rear area to light. The rear contacts remain local on the passivated silicon surface.

passages.locator: pp. 50–51, Commercial bifacial PERC+ modules and Table 2
passages.note: The authors identify LONGi among the suppliers of commercial glass–glass bifacial PERC+ modules, listing its LR6-60PD as an example.

file.representation: paraphrased research notes and selected factual observations
